I created `migrations/0001_add_last_login.sql`:

```sql
-- 0001_add_last_login
-- Records when each user last logged in. NULL means the user has never logged in.

ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_login_at TIMESTAMP NULL;
```

Nothing in the project will run this file yet. There's no migration runner, and the "database" is the in-memory object in `src/db.js`. I didn't add `last_login_at` to the user records there. I wrote plain `TIMESTAMP` because the project doesn't name a real database engine; if you're on Postgres, `TIMESTAMPTZ` would be the better choice.

If you want this to do something now, I can add `last_login_at: null` to the users in `src/db.js` and have `auth-service.js` set it on login. The file isn't committed yet.
